function u1._sendHover(u278, u279) -- Line: 1403
    -- upvalues: HOVER_MIN_INTERVAL_SECONDS (copy)
    if not u279.isSeller or u279.prompt == nil then
        return;
    end;

    local os_clock_ret = os.clock();

    if HOVER_MIN_INTERVAL_SECONDS <= os_clock_ret - u279.lastHoverSentAt then
        u279.lastHoverSentAt = os_clock_ret;
        u278._hover:FireServer(u279.prompt.promptId, u279.hovered or 0);

        return;
    end;

    if u279.hoverPending then
        return;
    end;

    u279.hoverPending = true;
    task.delay(HOVER_MIN_INTERVAL_SECONDS, function() -- Line: 1421
        -- upvalues: u279 (copy), u278 (copy)
        u279.hoverPending = false;

        if u278._board == u279 and u279.prompt ~= nil then
            u279.lastHoverSentAt = os.clock();
            u278._hover:FireServer(u279.prompt.promptId, u279.hovered or 0);
        end;
    end);
end;

local function envelopeAt(p85, p86) -- Line: 738
    if p86 <= p85[1][1] then
        return p85[1][2];
    end;

    for i = 2, #p85 do
        local v87 = p85[i - 1];
        local v88 = p85[i];

        if p86 <= v88[1] then
            local v89 = (p86 - v87[1]) / math.max(0.001, v88[1] - v87[1]);

            return v87[2] + (v88[2] - v87[2]) * v89;
        end;

        local _ = i;
    end;

    return p85[#p85][2];
end;

function u1._slotPosition(p163, p164) -- Line: 1051
    local _previewRig = p163._previewRig;
    local v165 = _previewRig:SectionPosition(p164) - _previewRig.centre;
    local v166 = v165:Dot(_previewRig.pointer:Cross(_previewRig.up));
    local v167 = v165:Dot(_previewRig.pointer);

    return UDim2.fromScale(0.5 + v166 / v168 * 0.5, 0.5 - v167 / v168 * 0.5);
end;

local function flipPose(p149, p150) -- Line: 970
    if p149 < 0.28 then
        local math_clamp_ret = math.clamp(p149 / 0.28, 0, 1);

        return p150 * (1 - (1 - math_clamp_ret) * (1 - math_clamp_ret)), 0;
    end;

    if p149 < 0.72 then
        local v151 = 3.141592653589793 * math.clamp((p149 - 0.28) / 0.44, 0, 1);

        return p150, 3.141592653589793 * (-(math.cos(v151) - 1) / 2);
    end;

    local math_clamp_ret = math.clamp((p149 - 0.72) / 0.28, 0, 1);

    return p150 * (1 - math_clamp_ret * math_clamp_ret), 3.141592653589793;
end;
